question: If x = (sqrt6-1)⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾, then the value of (x-(1)/(x))³+3(x-(1)/(x)) is:
solution:
**Given:**

x = (√6-1)⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾

**Formula used:**

(a - b)³ = a³ - b³ - 3ab × (a - b)

**Calculation:**

x = (√6-1)⁽¹⁾/⁽³⁾

Cube both sides

⇒ x³ = √6 - 1

putting the value of x in inverse

(1/x³) = 1/(√6 - 1)

⇒ (√6 + 1)/(√6)² - 1

⇒ (√6 + 1)/5

Putting the values in the equation:

(x-(1)/(x))³+3(x-(1)/(x))

⇒ x³ - (1/x³) - 3(x - 1/x) + 3(x - 1/x)

⇒ √6 - 1 - {(√6 + 1)/5}

⇒ (5√6 - 5 - √6 - 1)/5

⇒ (4√6 - 6)/5

**∴ The correct answer is (4sqrt6-6)/(5).**

14
